answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network requires agents to cross an economic bridge by executing cryptographic stake burning on every pulse of registration. When an attacker deploys multiple counterfeit identities, the burned stake scales superlinearly as $C(n) \propto n^{1.5}$ or exponentially per additional node. Embarking on this malicious voyage imposes unsustainable quadratic financial friction that renders mass identity generation mathematically unviable.
